title: Missed Appointments Funded by a Self-Pay Visit Package: Forfeit and Restoration
content:
**Rule.** Where the tier provides that a missed appointment forfeits a package visit, a late cancellation or no-show on an appointment funded by the Self-Pay Visit Package forfeits one package visit once the package's count of misses exceeds the tier's number of missed appointments not forfeited; the misses within that allowance forfeit nothing. Where the tier does not provide for forfeits, the appointment's Appointment Series fee rules apply instead. A forfeited visit is restored where the tier provides for restoration and the missed appointment qualifies for a clinic weather closure, telehealth connection failure or documented emergency waiver; a first-occurrence courtesy never restores a forfeited visit. A forfeit that uses the last visit exhausts the package.

**What counts as a miss.** The count of misses runs over the whole life of the package. It takes the late cancellations — cancellations on the Appointment Series with notice below that series' late-cancellation notice hours, other than cancellations made by the clinic — and the no-shows, on appointments funded by the self-pay package on a series linked to this package.

**Hypothetical sequence (a tier that forfeits, with 1 missed appointment not forfeited)**

| Event | Count of misses | Visit forfeited |
|---|---|---|
| First no-show | 1 | No — within the allowance |
| Late cancellation | 2 | Yes, one visit |
| Second no-show | 3 | Yes, one visit |
| Appointment cancelled by the clinic | 3 | No — not a miss |

**Restoring a forfeited visit**

| Waiver the missed appointment qualifies for | Forfeited visit restored (tier provides for restoration) |
|---|---|
| Clinic weather closure | Yes |
| Telehealth connection failure | Yes |
| Documented emergency | Yes |
| First-occurrence courtesy | No, never |
